item.title: Yanaka Old Town & Yanaka Ginza — Guide
item.description: Yanaka, in Tokyo’s Taito ward, is one of the few neighbourhoods to have survived the wars and disasters that reshaped the city, preserving the atmosphere of old ‘shitamachi’ (downtown) Tokyo. Its heart is Yanaka Ginza, a charming, lively retro shopping street lined with small, family-run shops selling snacks, croquettes, sweets, crafts and everyday goods — a wonderful place to stroll, sample street food and soak up a friendly, old-fashioned atmosphere far removed from Tokyo’s glass towers.
